text: INTEGRATE AND QUALIFY THE RESOURCE HUB ACTIVATION FIXES NOW (Samuel, verbatim intent). Keep the full Xenios Health mission active. Patch 6af2474357f31861200efd6be02624a4a8e8986b on branch claude/activation-fixes-20260908 (five files under server/research/resource-hub). A: check current source/ownership and selectively integrate the reviewed five-file patch onto the current integration branch; preserve newer production records and hardening; do not replace the branch wholesale with the helper's older base. B: independently review the recovery identity checks and conditional review updates; verify the ACTUAL managed persistence path, not only the recording double. Required checks: identical upload retry returns the correct existing version; different bytes or filename cannot become successful recovery; the loser cannot overwrite or publish the winner's resource; any residual private object/resource is accounted for — do not claim the entire failed attempt performed zero writes; concurrent review attempts cannot overwrite a winning decision; null and non-null reviewed_at filters work through the actual PostgREST path including timestamp round-trip; zero updated rows produces the intended conflict; provider errors remain distinguishable from success; the normal upload/review/approve/publish/download/withdraw journey works with the intended permissions and audit effects. Use an authorized disposable/managed qualification environment; do not improvise production test accounts, content or writes. A then: pin the integrated successor and complete required affected tests, typecheck/build, integrated suite, strict scan, manifest and source-bound review — this is a RUNTIME change, so do not reuse the old application PASS as if nothing changed; preserve the failed broad-run result and its isolated reruns; one heavy suite at a time; no silent timeout changes or skips. Once qualified, execute the corrected release and activation within the actual standing authorization and reviewed plan; keep unsupported content/account effects explicit; consolidate genuinely missing decisions into one request. Do not replay the already-installed migration unless a separately reviewed schema change genuinely requires a new migration. NEXT OUTPUT: B's exact verdict; A's integrated candidate; managed-service qualification result; release/activation execution result or exact remaining blocker. No new general planning cycle. — FABLE NOTE: Samuel's two qualifications are right and I am acting on them: (1) my broad server/research run stays recorded as a FAILED run with the 9/9 isolation rerun beside it, not as proof of contention; (2) my test title 'identical retry adds nothing' was too broad — a losing NEW-resource upload has already written its private object and an empty resource row before the version insert conflicts; I am correcting that test now to state exactly what residual remains (orphan object + zero-version resource row, never published, winner untouched) and adding a winner-unchanged assertion. A follow-up commit on the same branch will carry it; do not integrate 6af2474 alone.
